name: Inp-Video Ads Lite
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Inp-Video Ads Lite allows you to display a floating video widget on your website. Through an interactive video bubble, you can present a recorded message to your visitors and provide a direct button for them to contact you via WhatsApp.

This plugin provides an alternative way to engage with your audience by allowing you to display a video greeting instead of a standard static chat icon, creating a direct communication channel.

Lite Version Features

  • Video Widget: A floating video bubble that displays your custom .mp4 video on the screen.
  • WhatsApp Integration: Includes a button that connects visitors directly to your WhatsApp number.
  • Global Display: The video widget appears across all pages of your WordPress site.
  • Performance-Oriented: Uses native HTML5 video tags and loads asynchronously to minimize the impact on page load speed.
  • Customizable CTA: Modify the call-to-action button text to fit your needs.

For advanced features like multi-video support, page targeting, and custom colors, visit the official page at inp-web.com/inpvideo.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inp-video-ads-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Inp-Video Lite” section in your dashboard side menu to configure your video URL and WhatsApp number.
sections.faq:
Does the video slow down my page?

The plugin is designed to load asynchronously and uses native HTML5 video tags to help maintain your site’s performance.

What video format should I use?

We recommend using a web-optimized .mp4 format with a small file size for faster loading times.
